itemdesc-islandmap-tinmine: A weathered sea chart, one island circled in red. Hold it and use it to mark the Tin Mine on your world map.
itemdesc-islandmap-forest: A weathered sea chart, one island circled in red. Hold it and use it to mark the Forest Island on your world map.
itemdesc-islandmap-ideal: A weathered sea chart, one island circled in red. Hold it and use it to mark the Ideal Island on your world map.
itemdesc-islandmap-ironmine: A shipping chart, the ore route inked over many times. Hold it and use it to mark the Iron Mine on your world map.
itemdesc-islandmap-serpent: A captain's chart, one stretch of sea circled again and again. Hold it and use it to mark the Serpent's Nest on your world map.
itemdesc-islandmap-fortress: A weathered sea chart from the lighthouse keeper, one island circled in red. Hold it and use it to mark the Ruined Fortress on your world map.
